sources.title: Decree No. 289/2020: visa-free regime for Omani citizens
sources.publisher: Office of the President of Ukraine
sources.officialityEvidence: Ukraine's President publishes this operative decree on the official president.gov.ua domain; it names the Sultanate of Oman, its start date, and the stay limit.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Establish from 1 August 2020 a visa-free regime ... for citizens of ... the Sultanate of Oman.

sources.title: Visas to Jordan

sources.supportingExcerpt: Oman | Applicable | Visa can be obtained upon arrival.

policies.title: Omani ordinary passports: Ukraine visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Ukraine's operative presidential decree grants Omani citizens visa-free entry and transit for stays of up to 90 days in 180 days.
conditions: The waiver covers entry and transit for Omani citizens for no more than 90 days in any 180-day period.
It establishes the ordinary-passport short-visitor baseline, not work, residence, special travel documents, wartime operational access, or final admission.

policies.title: Omani ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's live Tourism Board nationality table expressly identifies Oman as eligible to obtain a visa on arrival.
conditions: The table identifies Oman as arrival-visa applicable without stating a fee.
Jordan's table also requires non-Jordanians to obtain a Gateway2Jordan QR code before departure.
Work, residence, special travel documents, entry-point limits, carrier checks and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Omani ordinary passports: Mongolia advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Mongolia's current official schedules limit the Oman waiver to diplomatic and special/service passports, omit Oman from the eVisa cohort, and direct other nationals to an embassy visa application.
conditions: Mongolia's live exemption schedule lists Oman only for diplomatic and special/service passports, not ordinary passports.
Oman is not in the Immigration Agency's current eVisa-eligible-country list; the Foreign Ministry directs other foreign nationals to submit an application at a Mongolian embassy.
This is an advance visitor-visa baseline, not a finding about work, residence, transit, diplomatic, special or service documents.

application.label: Mongolian diplomatic-mission visa application guidance
application.processingTime: The page says normal processing is three working days, with some applications taking five to ten working days.
steps: Apply at the nearest Mongolian diplomatic mission because the ordinary Omani passport is not in the listed exemption or eVisa cohorts.
Submit the ordinary tourist-visa requirements published by the competent Mongolian mission before travel.

policies.title: Omani ordinary passports: North Macedonia advance visitor visa
policies.summary: North Macedonia's live Foreign Ministry checker returns that Omani foreign citizens need a visa, and its procedure requires a visa before entry.
conditions: The Foreign Ministry's nationality checker returns 'Needed' for Oman.
Separate third-country-document entry waivers, if applicable, are not an ordinary Omani-passport baseline.
Work, residence, transit, special travel documents and final admission remain outside scope.

application.label: North Macedonia visa application procedure
steps: Apply through the competent North Macedonian diplomatic-consular representation before the intended trip.
Submit the application no more than six months and at least 15 days before travel.

conflicts.explanation: The fallback treats Omani passports as visa-free, while Jordan's live official nationality table says the visitor visa is obtained upon arrival.
